How to read a record

The level is a summary.
The record is the proof.

A Trusted level means identity is verified and at least three positive references — including one from a fellow artisan — have been confirmed. Open the record to see the actual evidence.

What verification is — and isn't

VeriPass confirms identity signals and records what named references have confirmed. It is not a guarantee of future work, a quote, or a substitute for your own judgement.

Always agree scope, timing and price directly.
